title: AutonomyPolicy
description: Execution authority policy for goal-level autonomous delivery. This is separate from routing policy, which only selects execution workflows.

pr_granularity.description: batch: tasks of a wave are validated in their own worktrees, integrated locally into one pico/batch-<n> branch, and published with one push and one PR referencing every included issue. task: one PR per task. Pushing and opening PRs still require permissions.push_branch and permissions.create_pr.

issue_reference.description: How a published PR body references its issue. refs (default): `Refs #N`, which never closes the issue, so a PR that only partly addresses it cannot close it by accident. closes: `Closes #N`, so GitHub closes the issue when the PR merges. The publication gate rejects closing keywords unless this is closes or the caller opts in explicitly (a workspace task's closes_issue).

parallel_tasks.description: Most routed tasks one wave may run concurrently (orchestration_record declare_wave enforces it).

open_prs.description: Most open batch PRs; when reached, new batches stack on the newest batch branch instead of opening another PR.

max_lead_calls.description: Optional repository default for the most model calls the lead may make in one run. At the limit the lifecycle extension allows only orchestration_record status or finish, then stops the run IN_PROGRESS (stopped_reason LEAD_CALL_LIMIT) for an explicit, higher-limit resume. An explicit task, manifest or --max-lead-calls limit overrides it. Omitted: no limit.

lead_calls_warn_at.description: Optional repository default for the lead call at which the lifecycle extension tells the lead, once, to converge. Must be below the effective max_lead_calls. Omitted: 80% of max_lead_calls, rounded down.
